blockers: no open record-level statewide crash data: AASHTOWare Safety needs an Access Indiana/ITAP account approved by INDOT; records otherwise through BuyCrash or a LexisNexis research request (fee)
no published export spec for AASHTOWare Safety; the only ARIES data dictionary (VCRS 2007/2009, NHTSA) is behind an Akamai block for scripts
user_actions: Request INDOT AASHTOWare Safety access: create an Access Indiana account (https://access.in.gov), log into ITAP (https://itap.indot.in.gov/Dashboard), 'Enroll New Application' -> AASHTOWare Safety; say it's for consultant safety studies. Or have an INDOT/LPA project manager ask INDOT's Office of Traffic Safety for the crash extract of the project area.

Once in, export crashes (collision level, with latitude/longitude, road and intersecting road, 'Crash Severity Level (NEW)') for the counties and years of the study, 5 years (2021-2025), as CSV; send the header row so the column map can be confirmed and a reader built.
Ask INDOT in writing whether an AASHTOWare export may be used inside a paid tool (licence unknown).
